title: Original Indexed Record Ownership
nativeCounterpart: PagedMap original entry_at/len owns ordered key/value entries
portable: One original record owns enumerable literal values and private ordered original key addresses
laws: No authored key or value copy for indexed source reads
No Object.keys/Object.entries enumeration in a retained read
No global cache or second value authority
Arbitrary literal keys including __proto__, constructor and metadata-like names
Cold decoder/command construction precedes original read publication
Immutable entry replacement constructs the next original owner; existing read owner stays unchanged
